Replace the defective envelope by a genuinely historical modulus that leaves contemporaneous treatment effects unrestricted except for boundedness:
\[
|Y_t(z_{1:t})-Y_t(z'_{1:t})|
\le
\sum_{\ell=1}^{t-1}C(1+\ell)^{-(1+\beta)}
\mathbf 1\{z_{t-\ell}\neq z'_{t-\ell}\},
\qquad\text{whenever }z_t=z'_t.
\]
Equivalently, for arbitrary path pairs one may display
\[
|Y_t(z_{1:t})-Y_t(z'_{1:t})|
\le
2B\,\mathbf 1\{z_t\neq z'_t\}
+\sum_{\ell=1}^{t-1}C(1+\ell)^{-(1+\beta)}
\mathbf 1\{z_{t-\ell}\neq z'_{t-\ell}\}.
\]
Treat the \(2B\) term only as the consequence of boundedness, not as lag-zero carryover and not as a strengthened structural assumption. Update every definition, theorem dependency, proof sketch, prose description, TLDR, seed, and sanity check that currently suggests the envelope controls the direct effect.

Parameterize the classes by the carryover radius:
\[
\mathcal P_{T,\beta}(C)
=
\{Y:\ |Y_t|\le B\text{ and the repaired historical envelope holds with radius }C\},
\qquad C\ge0.
\]
Use \(C>0\) for the principal oracle and adaptation results, while proving literally—not merely analogically—that
\[
\mathcal P_{T,\beta}(0)=\mathcal P_T^{(0)}
=
\{Y:\ |Y_t|\le B,\;
Y_t(z_{1:t})=Y_t(z'_{1:t})\ \text{whenever }z_t=z'_t\}.
\]
Define \(R_T(\beta;C)\) accordingly and state the sanity proposition as
\[
R_T(\beta;0)=R_T^{(0)}\asymp_B T^{-1/2}
\quad\text{for every }\beta,
\]
with an explicit upper construction using ordinary positive-probability binary randomization and a matching fixed-array lower bound. State that this is the \(C=0\) member of the same model and risk definition. Do not claim that the positive-\(C\) rate formula continuously specializes at \(C=0\).

Retain and re-prove the positive-\(C\) oracle claim
\[
R_T(\beta;C)\asymp T^{-\beta/(2\beta+1)}
\]
uniformly on \([\beta_-,\beta_+]\), now accounting explicitly for arbitrary time-varying contemporaneous direct effects. The upper proof obligation must separate the root-\(T\)-type randomization component from truncation bias \(O(b^{-\beta})\) and the effective-block variance \(O(\sqrt{b/T})\), yielding \(b_\beta\asymp T^{1/(2\beta+1)}\). The lower proof obligation must construct arrays satisfying the repaired envelope, with nonzero direct effects allowed, and establish indistinguishability uniformly over every \(\pi\in\mathcal D_T\), including deterministic, history-dependent, and outcome-adaptive kernels; do not silently impose positivity on the oracle design class.

E_\pi|\widehat\theta-\operatorname{GATE}_T(Y)|

simultaneously for every \(\beta\in[\beta_-,\beta_+]\). Define

E_\pi|\widehat\theta-\operatorname{GATE}_T(Y)|}

\]

\[
\mathscr L_T=\sigma\{\text{run-scale labels, run lengths, boundaries, terminal truncation, public scheduling seeds}\}
\]
and define \(\mathsf S_T\) to contain exactly this information, never the realized arms. For run \(r\), draw \(A_r\stackrel{\mathrm{ind}}{\sim}\mathrm{Bernoulli}(1/2)\), independently of \(\mathscr L_T\), and at its start use
\[
\mathcal F_{r-}=\mathscr L_T\vee\sigma(A_1,\ldots,A_{r-},Y^{\mathrm{obs}}\text{ before run }r),
\qquad
\Pr(A_r=a\mid\mathcal F_{r-})=\tfrac12.
\]
The full realized assignment record may contain the \(A_r\)’s after execution, but it must not be denoted or conditioned on as the public schedule. Delete every statement of the form \(\Pr(W_t=a\mid\mathsf S_T)=1/2\) when \(\mathsf S_T\) records arms. Define \(I_{t,b}(\mathsf S_T)\) as public \(b\)-eligibility and \(E_{t,b,a}=I_{t,b}\mathbf1\{A_{r(t)}=a\}\). Distinguish the known design probabilities
\[
\rho_{t,b}=\Pr\{I_{t,b}=1\},\qquad
p_{t,b,a}=\Pr(E_{t,b,a})=\rho_{t,b}/2,
\]
from the conditional run-arm propensity \(1/2\). Assert positivity only on the retained index set where \(\rho_{t,b}>0\). Assign every time through \(T\); an incomplete terminal run may contribute zero to a candidate estimator but must not leave \(W_t\) undefined.

Use a stationary/random-offset finite-horizon renewal implementation, or an explicitly specified boundary correction, so that all \(\rho_{t,b}\) are known and uniformly positive away from the declared boundary set. \]
